newsitem.title: UK: BFI jumps 23 points as north Atlantic rates rise.
newsitem.headline: BFI jumps 23 points as north Atlantic rates rise.

text.p: The BFI is up 23 to 1,118 on Thursday after the shortage of Panamaxes and handy-size bulkers in the North Atlantic brought a sharp increase in rates in this area, brokers said.
Charterers are now fixing modern Panamaxes at rates equivalent to $10,500 daily or more, basis delivery Continent trip via U.S. Gulf to Far East.
The Pacific market also continued to strengthen with a number of firmer 12-month time charter fixtures reported in the region of $8,500-$9,500 daily, brokers said.
There are also some signs of slightly better conditions for Capers in the Pacific, they added.
